hiring_bar_summary.text: High craft bar with a product-engineer (not pure-algorithm) flavour: the sourced posting screens for problem decomposition, UI quality, data-model fluency and business pragmatism in roughly equal weight, and the company is in-person (see red_flags). Experienced roles are senior-leaning (8+ years on the sourced posting).

Product/craft sensibility: familiarity with computing-pioneer design ideas is listed as a bonus, signalling taste/craft screening - stated signal, weight unknown

red_flags: In-person expectation (Anchor Days) is a hard constraint for relocation-averse candidates - confirm per-role before investing prep time.

Senior-leaning SWE postings (8+ years on the sourced role) mean new-grad odds via cold application are likely low - say so honestly per Doc 3 s3.
thesis_text: Bottom line: Notion hires product engineers, not algorithm specialists - the sourced posting weights problem decomposition, UI craft, data-model fluency and business pragmatism together, and the org is in-person in SF/NYC hubs. Who gets in: publicly, we cannot say - Notion publishes no cohort data and no licensed population sample exists yet for this record, so anyone quoting school or feeder percentages for Notion is guessing. Stated vs revealed: postings say imperfect-fit builders should apply; the revealed screen we can verify is seniority and craft (8+ years on the sourced Enterprise role, a named TypeScript/React/Node/Postgres stack). Routes in, ranked: (1) experienced lateral from a scaled product company with shipped, polished product work; (2) earlier-career builder route - a genuinely polished shipped product/portfolio that demonstrates craft, plus a referral to get it read; (3) cold application, weakest without the craft evidence. Gap to close for a typical student: a shipped product with real users and clean written explanation of design decisions - Notion screens writing explicitly. Plan: 30 days - ship/polish one product artifact and write it up; semester - one internship at a product-led company; year - target the experienced or occasional early-career postings as they appear (no fixed annual window found). Coffee chats: current Notion engineers on product teams; ask what the practical rounds actually test and how craft is judged. Risks/alternatives: in-person requirement; adjacent craft-led product companies (e.g. other prosumer SaaS) reward the same portfolio. Offer to execute: build the target list, tailor the resume to craft evidence, draft outreach.

section_confidence.process_stages: curated-qualitative - third-party reports only, labeled anecdotal

known_biases_of_data: Public postings describe the roles a company is currently trying to fill, not the people it actually hired; interview-prep and review sites are self-selected candidate reports; no licensed population dataset (PDL/Coresignal-class) was available for this record, so no school/employer/major shares are stated. Notion-specific: the posting mirror may lag the live posting; salary ranges are for SF and will differ by location/level.
